destinations.title: New Places.. Memories Worth Telling.
destinations.subtitle: From breathtaking natural landscapes to destinations waiting to be explored, every place with DUCK brings a distinct vibe and story. Pick your destination and discover what awaits.

aswan.name: Aswan Island
aswan.description: Elephantine Island in Aswan is one of the most historic and picturesque Nile islands, blending ancient Egyptian heritage with vibrant Nubian culture. Featuring the Temple of Khnum, ancient Nilometers, colorful Nubian heritage villages, palm groves, and tranquil eco-lodges.
aswan.alt: Nile scenery at Elephantine Island with Duck kayak

gharb.name: Gharb Soheil
gharb.description: A unique Nubian destination on the Nile's West Bank, famous for colorful domed houses and handcrafted souvenirs. Experience warm hospitality, timeless Nubian culture, camel rides, and scenic Nile adventures.
gharb.alt: Vibrant colorful Nubian village houses in Gharb Soheil

matrouh.name: Marsa Matrouh
matrouh.description: The jewel of Egypt's Mediterranean coast. Soft white sands and crystalline turquoise waters creating an unparalleled natural masterpiece. The ideal haven for tranquility and coastal adventure.
matrouh.alt: Crystal clear turquoise waters along the Marsa Matrouh coast

giza.name: Giza
giza.description: Where timeless history meets the serene Nile. Blending ancient grandeur with modern vitality, offering stunning views and a refreshing river escape right beside historical landmarks.
giza.alt: Nile palms and the Great Pyramids in Giza

siwa.name: Siwa Oasis
siwa.description: A timeless sanctuary of desert mystique and history, once known as the Oasis of Amun. Surrounded by date groves, natural cold springs, and salt lakes — a sunset kayak experience suited for everyone.
siwa.alt: Siwa protected area cold lake amidst the desert sands

destinations.eyebrow: Where Will Your Next Adventure Take You?
destinations.introText: From the tranquil Nile to wild natural beauty, each destination offers a chance to live a fresh story and uncover a new side of the place.

trips.title: Choose Your Experience.. Leave the Rest to Us.
trips.subtitle: Everyone has their own way of enjoying the water, and every experience brings a distinct vibe. Pick what suits you and discover the Nile your way.

botanicalGarden.title: Tour around Botanical Island
botanicalGarden.desc: Kayak around the Botanical Island: serene waters, exotic trees and rare flora from across the world, away from the crowds. Spot native birds and capture unforgettable memories.
botanicalGarden.alt: Kayaking around the Botanical Island in Aswan

supNile.title: Nile Stand-Up Paddleboard Experience
supNile.desc: Paddle tranquil waters around Elephantine Island with vistas of the river, granite islets, and Nubian heritage. No prior experience needed; full safety instruction provided.
supNile.alt: Stand-up paddleboarding on the Nile in Aswan

slougaGhazal.title: Salouga & Ghazal Islands Escape
slougaGhazal.desc: Escape to the pristine beauty of Salouga & Ghazal protected islands. Paddle through peaceful Nile channels, explore hidden archipelagos, and view local wildlife. Daily 7 AM – 6 PM except Fridays.
slougaGhazal.alt: Kayaking in Salouga and Ghazal protected islands in Aswan

kayakPrivate.title: Kayak — Private Guided Tour
kayakPrivate.desc: A relaxed, premium experience with a dedicated professional captain accompanying you all the way.
kayakPrivate.alt: Private guided kayak tour on the Nile

kayakFree.title: Kayak — Open Free Tour
kayakFree.desc: An open kayak tour on the Nile around Elephantine Island in serene, welcoming waters suitable for all.
kayakFree.alt: Open kayak tour near Elephantine Island

gharbExplorer.title: Gharb Soheil — Explorer Tour
gharbExplorer.desc: A comfortable and safe journey with a licensed captain throughout the tour.
gharbExplorer.alt: Explorer kayak tour in Gharb Soheil

gharbAdventure.title: Gharb Soheil — Adventure Tour
gharbAdventure.desc: Crafted for confident paddlers with previous kayaking experience.
gharbAdventure.alt: Adventure kayak tour in Gharb Soheil

omElrakham.title: Um El-Rakham Beach Tour
omElrakham.desc: An hour of turquoise adventure in crystal-clear waters and striking Mediterranean coastal views. Self-guided for swimmers with basic kayak handling skills.
omElrakham.alt: Kayaking in Um El-Rakham beach in Marsa Matrouh

ageebaBeach.title: Ageeba Beach Tour
ageebaBeach.desc: An hour of turquoise adventure in crystal-clear waters and striking Mediterranean coastal views. Self-guided for swimmers with basic kayak handling skills.
ageebaBeach.alt: Kayaking in Ageeba beach in Marsa Matrouh

waterbikeNile.title: Water Bike on the Nile
waterbikeNile.desc: Exciting water bike ride on the Nile — strictly 2 units available per time slot. Ideal for couples and friends, with certified life vests. No swimming required.
waterbikeNile.alt: Water bike on the Nile at sunset

gizaAbbasBridge.title: Giza — Abbas Bridge Tour
gizaAbbasBridge.desc: In the historic heart of Giza on the Nile: a full hour of kayaking for everyone, solo or with friends and family, no prior experience needed. Daily from sunrise to sunset.
gizaAbbasBridge.alt: Kayaking on the Nile near Abbas Bridge in Giza

faq.title: Got a Question? We’re Here to Help.
faq.subtitle: We gathered the essential details you need to know before starting your DUCK experience.

sideCard.title: Didn't find your answer?
sideCard.desc: Our team is ready to answer on WhatsApp, including groups and corporate requests.
sideCard.prefill: Hello, I have a question about Duck:

isSafe.a: Yes. All our activities are designed to be completely safe. We provide certified life jackets, comprehensive safety briefings before departure, and continuous support throughout the journey.

needSwim.q: Do I need to know how to swim?
needSwim.a: No, not at all. Certified life jackets keep you safe even if you are not a swimmer.

duration.q: How long does the trip take?
duration.a: Trip duration depends on the package selected. The standard package includes an equipped kayak, life jacket, and paddle.

maxWeight.q: What is the maximum participant weight?
maxWeight.a: Maximum weight limit is 130 kg per participant.

suitableFor.q: Who is the activity suitable for?
suitableFor.a:
Our activities are suitable for:
• Solo adventurers
• Friends
• Families
• Tourists

minAge.q: Is there a minimum age limit?
minAge.a: Yes. Children must be accompanied by an adult. Requirements may vary depending on activity type.

whatToWear.a:
We recommend:
• Comfortable clothing
• Shorts or activewear
• Light shoes or water sandals

phoneAllowed.a: Yes, but we strongly recommend a waterproof pouch or keeping it safely stored ashore.

photography.a: Professional photography packages are available upon request.

howToBook.a: You can book seamlessly through our website. For group and corporate bookings, contact us directly.

cancellation.a:
Yes. Cancellation and refund policy:
• Free cancellation up to 24 hours prior (100% full refund)
• Less than 24 hours prior: non-refundable
• No-show: non-refundable
• Adverse weather or force majeure: rescheduled or full refund provided
• Delays: we hold an operational grace window; failure to attend is treated as a no-show

operatingHours.a: We operate daily from sunrise to sunset. Winter is great all day, while summer is best during sunrise and sunset.

whatIncluded.q: What is included in a standard experience?
whatIncluded.a: Every standard package covers the equipped craft (Kayak, SUP board, or Water Bike), a certified life jacket, safety briefing, and on-water support.

paymentMethods.q: Which payment options confirm my booking?
paymentMethods.a: You can lock your booking with full payment or a 50% deposit via InstaPay and send the transfer screenshot alongside your reference code on WhatsApp.

arrivalTime.a: Please arrive at the launch point at least 15 minutes before departure for gear fitting and a quick safety briefing.

reschedule.q: Can I reschedule or modify my booking?
reschedule.a: Yes! You can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 24 hours ahead, and we also reschedule free in adverse weather.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We respect your privacy and safeguard your booking and contact details.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect only the details necessary to confirm your booking and coordinate your launch point and time slot (such as your name, WhatsApp number, and booking preferences).

sections.heading: How We Use Information
sections.body: Your information is used strictly for dispatch coordination, digital ticket verification, and customer support via WhatsApp. We never sell or share data with unrelated third parties.

sections.heading: Security & Retention
sections.body: Account details follow standard security controls, and you may reach out anytime via WhatsApp or email to update or remove your account records.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Approved operational rules to keep every water experience safe and seamless.

sections.heading: Safety & Participation
sections.body: Wearing a certified life jacket and following guide briefings is mandatory throughout every activity. Maximum participant weight is 130 kg, and children must be accompanied by an adult.

sections.heading: Arrival & Operating Hours
sections.body: We operate daily from sunrise to sunset. Please arrive at your launch point at least 15 minutes ahead of your scheduled departure.

sections.heading: Booking Confirmation
sections.body: Reservations are locked once transfer payment (full amount or 50% minimum deposit) and receipt screenshot are shared with our official WhatsApp team.

cancellation.title: Cancellation & Rescheduling Policy
cancellation.subtitle: Fair, transparent rules to protect your booking flexibility.

sections.heading: Free Cancellation (24h+)
sections.body: You may cancel free of charge with a full refund up to 24 hours prior to your scheduled experience start time.

sections.heading: Under 24 Hours & No-Show
sections.body: Cancellations less than 24 hours ahead or no-shows are non-refundable due to dedicated fleet and guide allocation.

sections.heading: Weather & Force Majeure
sections.body: If adverse weather or river conditions prevent safe operation, we offer complimentary rescheduling or an immediate 100% refund.
